description: Renovate covers the GitHub Actions workflows only.
The sbt build is owned by Scala Steward (.github/workflows/scala-steward.yml).
This repository exists to consume io.github.oluies::p4rt-scala, so tracking
each new release of it is the whole maintenance loop, and Steward is what
does that -- successfully, as of 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-19.
Renovate understands sbt as well, which is exactly the problem: the default
onboarding config detected build.sbt and project/build.properties, so leaving
the sbt manager enabled would have both bots opening the same bump. Scoping
Renovate to github-actions keeps the two from duplicating each other -- the
same boundary used in oluies/scala-hotwire and oluies/ddd-sample-scala.
